How to get your boarding pass

1

Find your booking

Identify yourself using your name and 6-digit booking reference or ticket number.

2

Sign in with Travel ID

Sign in with your existing Travel ID — or create one in just a few steps — to continue with online check-in.

Create Travel ID

3

Complete your travel details

Provide the required travel information and travel documents for your flight and destination.

4

Personalize your flight

Select a seat for yourself and anyone travelling with you. Add available services such as baggage or upgrades.

In case you don’t know the airline booking reference or the ticket number please use the following option to access the online check-in with the booking details received from your travel agency or tour operator.

Online check-in with tour operator details The link will be opened in a new browser tab
